Jindal Steel Q2 profit rises 21% as revenue hits record Rs 19,448 crore
items.summary: Jindal Steel’s Q2 FY26 profit rose 21% year-on-year to Rs 771 crore, while revenue surged 44% to a record Rs 19,448 crore. Higher steel production and sales boosted earnings, while adjusted EBITDA grew 33% and net debt declined sequentially.
